question: Aga Khan Cup' is associated with the game of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'Aga Khan Cup' -__

 __
 
• It is associated with hockey.
 
• Another name for the Aga Khan Cup is the Bayton Cup.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hockey -

 
 
• The first organized club in hockey is 'Blackheath Abbey & Club', established in 1861.
 
• The highest body of hockey is Federation De Hockey. It was established in 1884.
 
• Hockey's first World Cup was played in 1971 and has been held every 4 years since then.
 
• Other major trophies related to Hockey - Sultan Azlan Shah Cup, Sultan Johor Cup, etc.
 
 
 
• ​Tennis -
 
 
• It has four main events at the world level, which are called 'Grand Slam'.
 
• Every year the Australian Open in Australia in January, the French Open in France in May, and two weeks later, Wimbledon in London, held in the US in September, is called the American Open (US Open for short).
 
• Wimbledon is played on a grass court.
 
• The French Open is played on a clay court.
